verdict.rationale: CSC shows that its account platform keeps documents for ongoing access: filed evidence is uploaded to CSCNavigator for 24x7 access (csc-docs-9), entity management includes a document repository with folder routing (csc-docs-18), and SOP documents are delivered as searchable PDFs, a point listed on the CSCNavigator page (csc-docs-13). However, the evidence never says that received service-of-process notices themselves are archived and retrievable months after the notification. missing for 10: explicit documentation that received SOP/notices are retained in the account, retention period and history/search of past notices, independent or hands-on corroboration.
